text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'd like your opinion on something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet is acting strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
For example, when I passed her in the
hall this
morning...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wha?! U-ummm...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right. ...Morning.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And also, the other night in the
cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet. Would you like to eat
together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh?! S-sure... Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Something seems off with her. Do you
think I did
something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea, but... in times like this,
when
something seems strange, the
fastest solution is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I wasn't trying to make you

uncomfortable!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I realized something when I was
looking
over all the Twinkle Series
results. I...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was pretty confident about
running miles,
but you've got a better
record than I do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This isn't how I usually feel when I lose a
race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This feeling is more... aggressive. It's not
befitting
of the academy's number one
honor student. And
I keep finding myself
on the verge of saying
something blunt
when I talk to you...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I've been trying to keep
some
distance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would letting your feelings slip be such
a bad
thing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, it might not be a bad thing, per se...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I want to be nice to you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I think I get it. How about something
like this,
then?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It was a total fluke that you won! Next
time, I'll
beat you so bad you'll be
coughing up dust for a
week!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'd mind if you said
something like
that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I think that might be...
preferable, even.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That would make you happy?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I had no idea. I'm sorry I couldn't
figure
that out on my own.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I can come up with things
like that
off the top of my head... but I
won't hide my
feelings from you
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So I hope you're ready, Machan.
Because I'll be
winning the next mile,
thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Perfect. I look forward to facing you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Aston Machan has grown a
bit closer
to Daiwa Scarlet.
